shortDescription.default: SharePoint Admin Center - one dashboard for everyday SharePoint administration

longDescription.default: Administer SharePoint sites from one place as the signed-in user, with no app registration or client ID: tenant site inventory, people and permissions, bulk user management, lists and libraries, storage insights, recycle bin, activity feed and a health check. Throttle-safe by design: paced requests, Retry-After handling, caching, and search-index aggregates instead of file enumeration. Optional Microsoft 365 features (live tenant usage sync, Microsoft 365 group owners and members, ownerless groups, guest review) use delegated Microsoft Graph permissions that a Global Administrator approves once in SharePoint admin center > API access; everything else works without them.
